clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, A Torn Journal Page links an old crate to Stalvan Mistmantle's past. Its worn script points toward records kept in Elwynn Forest.

A Torn Journal Page lies in a sealed storage crate beside Stormwind City's canals. Old books, family heirlooms, and a ceramic vase surround the worn fragment among forgotten personal effects. Its distinct handwriting points to Stalvan Mistmantle's past, though the page is damaged and hard to read. Who in the kingdom might recognize the hand that wrote it?
